description: IRQ 用户态化：IRQ_BIND capability + irq_bind/irq_forward syscall

notes.scope: kernel/src/irq_forward.rs（IRQ 0~23 静态绑定表 + Notification CapRef + 进程 PID）；Device kind 新增 IRQ_BIND 权限位；syscall irq_bind(device_cap, irq_vector, notification_cap, rights_mask)；idt#IRQ handler 尾巴调 irq_forward_dispatch(vector) → signal notification；审计埋点 EventKind::IrqBind
notes.design-contract: Doc 07 §1.1 + Doc 08 §1.1 一致契约：内核只做 MMIO/IRQ 转发（capability 控制）；Doc 04 §3.1 唯一网络出口不变量的物理基础
notes.cross-task-dep: 依赖 P4-T7 IPC 通路 + P4-T11 审计；与 P4-T13 cap_invoke 共用 cap_resolve helper
notes.extension-defer: 扩展 IRQ 24~47（IOAPIC）留 P6 SMP；本期仅 legacy PIC IRQ 0~15 + cascade 2~3
